meta.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive - Nintendo Official Site
meta.description: Get moving in Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Play 12 motion-control sports including Bowling, Basketball, and Skateboarding.

content.value: Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports!
Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls.
Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling—there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!
Explore the island getaway using Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, and tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.
Create and customize your Sportsmate or Mii™ characters, and jump into the fun online* or offline** in Nintendo Switch Sports Resort!
Details about how many people can play together online will be provided in the future.

fields.text: Be aware of your surroundings. Wear wrist straps and allow adequate room around you during game play.

*Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/purchase-terms/
**Additional accessories may be required for multiplayer mode. Sold separately.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100125145\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and much more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, battle with one thumb to hand your opponent a defeat in Thumb Wrestling—there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

You can ride across the Wuhu Island resort getaway using Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, or tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.

Create and customize your Sportsmate or Mii™ characters, and jump into the fun online* or offline**, when the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort™ game launches exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on October 22.

Details about how many people can play together online will be provided in the future.
